The formalization constructs a countable metric space with all distinct points at distance at least one whose real Lipschitz-free space has the approximation property but fails every bounded approximation bound. The metric space is unbounded and not proper.” “The earlier quantitative renorming result for real $\ell_1$ is retained: for each integer $p\ge1$, an equivalent complete norm has the $2B_p$-bounded approximation property but fails the $p$-bounded approximation property, where $B_p=300p^2+150p+5$.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
